content.comment_body: Hello, I previously used [product_name] with Ethernet quite a while ago, and now I have a brand new [article_no]. I set its IP address to 192.168.0.1 and attempted to download a program originally from another [article_no], but it neither downloads nor prompts for a password. The LAN LED changes from green to flashing yellow. I also tried another new [product_name]—same result. Interestingly, connecting to an already working [article_no] allows me to upload and connect without problems. I must be missing something; any info you can share to help resolve this would be appreciated. Happy New Year. ...sent from App

If you are working with both a [article_no] and a [article_no], it's likely a version issue with your [product_name] software. For first-generation [product_name], version [version_no] is sufficient. For more recent generations, you need at least [version_no], but using the latest version is strongly recommended. The upgrade is free and can be downloaded from [url]. This package includes several tools and is about 1.3 GB in size. Once downloaded, make sure to run the update with administrator rights.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing trouble downloading programs to new [product_name] hardware, particularly when transferring configurations from older units. Noticeable symptoms include unclear hardware feedback (such as changing LED indicators) and missing password prompts. The key issue identified is a mismatch between software version and device firmware. Ensuring the [product_name] software is compatible and updated resolves these obstacles.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for seamless program transfers between different [product_name] versions, without compatibility concerns or forced troubleshooting of software versions.
